plan.title: Single-stage RFQ All Vendors save with no selection

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title so the setup can reach the participant controls.
Choose the first available RFQ template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Verify the All Vendors control is available.
Verify that the All Vendors dialog closes.
Verify that no application error is shown after saving.
